_comment: Locations. id is added to LOCATION_ID_BASE and never reused (retired: 4, a pickup found inside a building that opens later, 2026-09-24). source says how the game marks it done: an EventControl event plus the global flag it sets (see agent_docs/MEASURED.md). The client sends a check when that flag becomes true. source.give, where known, is the |giveitem,type,item,...| that hands out the vanilla item on that map (type 0 item, 1 key item, 2 medal): the client keeps it out of the inventory and shows the seed's item instead. source.pickup is an item lying in the world (or buried in a dig spot): its flag is the pickup's own activationflag (agent_docs/MEASURED.md, "World pickups"), type is the item kind (0 item, 1 key item, 2 medal) and item its id; the client knows it by map and flag. Artifacts are events (no id): the game counts 7 artifact flags, and the goal is having enough of them. A location's requires lists event or item names it needs beyond its region. story_events are logic-only events (no id): a story step, placed in the region where it happens, whose item other rules require. requires is what the spot itself needs once you're in the room (the user, 2026-09-24: kept apart from what reaching the room needs, so entrance rando can change the second without touching the first); written even when the region already implies it.

regions.name: Snakemouth Den Underground
regions._comment: Every Snakemouth room with water droplets, or reached only through one (from the dump's doors: MushroomPit, UndergrondDoor, Underground*, TreasureRoom, Empty). Leif freezes the droplets (the user, 2026-09-24).

story_events.name: Leif Joins
story_events._comment: Leif joins the party at the Snakemouth Den lake (the MothEvent trigger starts Event14, which sets flag 16; MEASURED.md). The lake is reachable without passing any room with water droplets, so Leif comes before everything that needs him.
